title: Fort Chambly

terrainReference.basis: Original landward terrain outside the middle of the west curtain. Local doorway and riverbank grade remain approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap fort relation 1554213, with outer way 109746492 and courtyard way 109746494. Park geometry carries the site Wikidata identity, separate from the fort perimeter.
mapIdentity.scope: The masonry fort follows OpenStreetMap relation 1554213, outer way 109746492 and courtyard way 109746494. The four mapped corner projections remain visible above the curtain walls. The modeled ranges leave the mapped courtyard open.

note: June 2003 photographs establish the weathered stone walls, low bastion roofs, red courtyard dormers and arched openings. Unseen roof divisions, stonework, heights and the landward entrance details are estimates. The original riverbank field remains unchanged.
